recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.lead: Rent, phone, internet, subscriptions — anything that repeats is recorded as an expense on its date, by itself or after your confirmation.
recurring.first_date_help: Repeats on the same day of the month (or the month's last day when shorter).
recurring.end_help: For example when the lease ends.

mode_help.auto: Automatic — recorded on its date with no click (a fixed amount like rent)
mode_help.confirm: After confirmation — waits for review because the amount may change (phone, electricity)

recurring.due_banner: {n} recurring expense(s) are due and waiting for confirmation.
recurring.empty_text: Add the rent, internet and phone once and let them be recorded every month.
recurring.how: Automatic ones are recorded as expenses on their date even if nobody opens the system. “After confirmation” ones wait here so you can enter the actual amount, then record or skip. Salaries need no recurring expense — they come from the payroll pages.

payouts.bank_lead: The month's salary file for each bank in the layout it asks for — download it or e-mail it to the bank as an attachment.
payouts.templates_lead: Each bank has its own file layout: columns, order and labels, CSV or Excel, and the bank's e-mail. Works with any bank.
payouts.start_text: Start from a ready layout and adjust the columns and labels to what your bank asks for, or build one from scratch.

preset_hint.simple: Name, IBAN, bank, amount and currency
preset_hint.detailed: Plus the clinic account, value date, job title and e-mail

payouts.any_bank: Ask your bank for its salary file template (required columns, their order, date format and separator) and describe it here once. A person whose bank name matches a layout's name or one of its other spellings goes into that bank's file; the rest go into the default layout.
payouts.none_title: Nobody to transfer to this month
payouts.none_text: Prepare the staff or doctor salaries of the month first.
payouts.iban_help: Used for salary transfers (Bank transfer page).
payouts.fix_accounts: People with no account or an invalid IBAN are left out of the file — fix their details on the staff page or the doctor's profile.
payouts.bank_email_help: The file is sent to it as an attachment from the clinic's mail.
payouts.mark_paid: Mark them paid by bank transfer
payouts.bank_emailed: The file of {n} people was sent to {to}.
payouts.match_help: Comma separated, e.g. Arab Bank, العربي — to match the bank name written on staff records.
payouts.is_default: Default layout (for people whose bank matches no layout)
payouts.header_row: First row holds the column titles
payouts.columns_help: In the order the bank asks for. The label is what appears in the first row.
payouts.slip_all_confirm: Send this month's paid payslips to every staff member and doctor who has not received theirs?

err.NO_EMAIL: This person has no e-mail address — add it to their details.
err.NO_MAIL: E-mail is not set up — connect the clinic's mail in Settings.
err.MAIL_FAILED: The e-mail could not be sent; try again later.
err.NO_PAYEES: Choose at least one person with a valid account.

msg.slip_body:
Hello {name},
Please find attached your payslip for {period}.
Kind regards,
{clinic}
msg.bank_body:
Dear {bank},
Please find attached the salary file for {period}: {count} beneficiaries, total {total}, from the clinic account {account}.
Kindly process it.
Kind regards,
{clinic}

payouts.draft_confirm: The month is not paid yet — the payslip will be sent as a draft. Continue?
